title: spec(+ui): `navigation.mode` keeps `page | drawer | new_window | none` — `modal`, `split` and `popover` are retired; the default becomes `drawer` in the schema and in the console (no field-count guess); list-page `recordAction` drops `modal`; the console's split pane becomes a per-user preference read
body:
Part of the record-page-v2 epic #26676 (child 1 of 4).

## Source (origin/main `416a76030e`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2420` `NavigationModeSchema = z.enum(['page', 'drawer', 'modal', 'split', 'popover', 'new_window', 'none'])`, and `:2467` `mode: NavigationModeSchema.default('page')`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:1069` `recordAction: z.enum(['drawer', 'page', 'modal', 'none'])` (describe says "Default: drawer"), reached also through the aliases at `:1016` (`onRecordClick`, `rowAction`, `openIn`); `packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts:182-190` offers `Modal` as an option (`:187`).
- The console guesses: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` resolves an un-authored view to `deriveRecordSurface(objectDef) === 'page' ? { mode: 'page' } : { mode: 'drawer', … }` (field-heavy objects page by themselves); `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts:364` `const mode: NavigationMode = navigation?.mode ?? 'page'` (the hook's own fallback is `page`) and `:366` `isOverlay = mode === 'drawer' || mode === 'modal' || mode === 'split' || mode === 'popover'` — the hook has no other per-mode branch for the three values; the same guess also sits in `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1661` (`schema.layout || deriveRecordSurface(...)`) and is documented in `ui/content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx:301`, `:356` and `ui/packages/plugin-view/README.md:91`, `:423`; `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts:3336` `export type ViewNavigationConfig = NavigationConfig` is an alias of the spec type, so the narrowing reds `Type Check UI` by itself; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts:274` `IN_PAGE_RECORD_OVERLAYS = new Set(['modal', 'split', 'popover'])`; `ObjectView.tsx:1010` / `:1133` draw the split face from `navOverlay.mode === 'split'`; `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-gantt` honour the authored mode through `NavigationOverlay` (its docblock in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` says so).
- HotCRM on `1f3f8880` declares `mode: 'page'` (lead) and `mode: 'drawer'` (opportunity, task, case) — none of the retired values; no sibling card is needed there.

## Target

1. `NavigationModeSchema` is `['drawer', 'page', 'new_window', 'none']`, default `drawer`; `modal`, `split`, `popover` are retired per the `spec-property-retirement` skill (tombstone through `retiredKey()` in `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts` with the prescription "delete the value; `drawer` is the default, declare `page` only for an object whose record should open as a full page; a side-by-side pane is a reader's own preference in the list's Display menu, not metadata"; ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset; `gen:authorable-surface-base` baseline; forms, docs and skills text).
2. `InterfacePageConfigSchema.recordAction` is `['drawer', 'page', 'none']`, same kit, and `page.form.ts` drops the `Modal` option.
3. The console's resolution order becomes: the authored `page` wins; `drawer` otherwise — the `deriveRecordSurface` field-count guess is retired from the list → record path in `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts:81-83` and in `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1661`, and the two doc pages stop teaching it (mobile still pages, that is viewport, not declaration). The hook's fallback at `useNavigationOverlay.ts:364` becomes `drawer` to match the schema default and `:366` is trimmed; `IN_PAGE_RECORD_OVERLAYS` shrinks accordingly. `NavigationOverlay` (the component) is mounted by nine callers (InterfaceListPage, ObjectDataPage, ObjectView, objectViewRecordOverlay, ObjectGrid, ObjectCalendar, ObjectGantt, ObjectKanban, RecordDetailDrawer): a `modal` / `popover` face that no caller can reach once the values are gone from metadata is deleted; a face still reached by a non-metadata caller stays — measure the callers, do not delete by name. Out of scope: the record FORM's modal-vs-page decision (`recordFormNavigation.ts`, `AppContent.tsx:889`) is a different surface and stays as it is.
4. The split pane survives as a per-user preference: a small app-shell util (`recordOpenPreference` — `'drawer' | 'split'`, default `drawer`, stored in `localStorage`) that `ObjectView` reads in place of `navOverlay.mode === 'split'`; the Display-menu control that writes it is #26681, so this card ships the read side and a test, not the control.
5. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 4: a removal that reds `ui/` ships with the `ui/` fix in the same PR — `git grep` the three values under `ui/` before pushing; this card's `ui/` fix is authorized by ruling 1.

## File surface

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `page.zod.ts`, `page.form.ts`, the retirement kit files (re-read the kit: `dbf7e04adf` of 2026-10-27 changed how kits age out), spec tests; `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/{ObjectView,objectViewRecordNavigation,objectViewRecordOverlay}.tsx|ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`; `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` and its `deriveRecordSurface` docs (`ui/content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, `ui/packages/plugin-view/README.md`); `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` only for faces measured unreachable; `plugin-grid` / `plugin-calendar` / `plugin-kanban` / `plugin-gantt` navigation reads; tests beside; changesets (`narrowed`, BREAKING with migration).

## Acceptance

1. `safeParse` of `navigation: { mode: 'split' }`, `'modal'`, `'popover'` and `recordAction: 'modal'` fail with the tombstone prescription (assert `code` + `status` + the first sentence of the message); `{ mode: 'drawer' }`, `{ mode: 'page' }`, an absent `mode` parse, and the parsed default is `drawer`.
2. A list of an object with no authored navigation opens a record in the drawer whatever its field count (the pin that asserted the field-count page is flipped and carries the new semantics, not just deleted).
3. An object or view declaring `page` still navigates to the record route; `new_window` and `none` unchanged.
4. With the preference util set to `split`, `ObjectView` draws the split face; default draws the drawer.
5. `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface` and the spec retirement gates green; `Type Check UI` green on the same PR.

## Rulings (maintainer, 2026-10-27, chat in the filing session — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. The model, quoted back by the maintainer and ordered built: 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the drawer's top bar: 「左上角的 任务 · 2 / 2 · 分屏 几个字有必要嘛」 — no object name, no mode label on the bar.
3. On the position counter: 「我觉得记录详情页显示第几条记录 好像也没必要」 — no "n / N" anywhere on a record; the ↑ ↓ previous / next controls stay.
4. On the right pane: 「右侧应该可以拖动吗？展开为整页那个是不是用图标就可以」 — the pane is drag-resizable and "open as full page" is an icon-only control with a tooltip.
5. On related records, the maintainer confirmed the in-place model: 「所以关联记录是一层一层的往下点，然后可以一层一层的反悔吗」 — one level down per click, one level back per ← / Esc, never a second drawer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-27, from the record-page / list-page assessment and the clickable prototype the maintainer walked and ruled on in that session (objectstack main `416a76030e`, HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0). The maintainer's instruction to build it, verbatim: 「你直接立卡派发处理这个开发，然后审核。」 Design evidence (never merged): branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` at commit `345ec777220843ce1fd7f95b6cc0b2b6dcc81bf8`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/` (`prototype.html`, `artboards/`, `assessment.md`).</sub>
